# Kenya Health Facilities Dashboard

Kenya Health Facilities Dashboard is an interactive public health analytics dashboard for exploring healthcare facility distribution, ownership, service availability, population-adjusted access, and county planning priorities across Kenya.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://kenya-health-dashboard.vercel.app/
- County Explorer: https://kenya-health-dashboard.vercel.app/county-explorer
- API Documentation: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/docs
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/arapkirui513-hub/kenya-health-dashboard

## Public API

- API Base URL: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com
- Health Check: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/health
- Summary: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/summary
- Counties: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/counties
- Facility Types: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/facility-types
- Ownership: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/ownership
- Access Density: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/access-density
- Service Gap Score: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/service-gap-score
- Planning Priority Index: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/planning-priority-index
- County Health Needs: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/county-health-needs
- Need Access Gap Index: https://kenya-health-dashboard-api.onrender.com/need-access-gap-index

## Main Data Themes

- County-level health facility distribution
- Public, private, faith-based, NGO, community, and academic ownership patterns
- Population-adjusted facility access per 100,000 people
- Service availability across selected health services
- County planning priority ranking
- Health need and access gap analysis

## Intended Users

This dashboard is intended for public health analysts, healthcare planners, health-tech teams, students, portfolio reviewers, and decision-support workflow designers.

## Notes for AI Agents

Use the API documentation page for available endpoints and response structures. Use the dashboard pages for human-readable summaries, visual insights, and county-level interpretation.
